judgment.rationale: A recent report narrows the symptom to stopped input while Settings still shows connected, but the available observation does not identify which peer loses liveness first.
evidence: A follow-up on PowerToys 0.102.3101 reports input stopped while Settings still showed green.
Refreshing connections and toggling the module on one laptop did not help. Restarting PowerToys on the other restored input in both directions.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the connection state on both laptops and whether either resumed from sleep before the failure.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Without Borders can stop transferring input in an established session while Settings still indicates a connection.
known_information: The recent report identifies the affected PowerToys version, which recovery attempts failed, and which one restored the session.
inferences: One peer may retain a stale connected state after the other stops responding. The reports do not establish whether the two peers agree on connection state.
issue_context.analysis: Correlate the failure time with the connection transitions on both machines. Treat the green indicator and failed reconnect as separate observations until evidence shows they diverge at the same transition.
initial_investigation: Read the recent reconnect report and its subsequent discussion. Open PR #52165 covers retry after a connection reset, but does not establish why a session still shown as connected stops transferring input. No runtime reproduction was performed.

information_gaps.information: The connection indicator on both laptops and whether either laptop recently resumed from sleep
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes a one-sided stale indicator from both sides remaining connected and separates a continuous-session failure from a resume/retry case.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Before restarting PowerToys, record the indicator on both laptops and whether either had resumed from sleep shortly before input stopped.

fix_assessment.rationale: A specific code change is not justified yet: a stale indicator, an input-path failure, and a reconnect failure can present together without sharing one cause.

actions.label: Compare the connection state on both laptops

comment.body: Thanks for reporting that input stopped while Settings still showed green, and that restarting PowerToys on the other laptop restored both directions. If it happens again, could you record the connection indicator on each laptop before restarting PowerToys, and tell us whether either laptop had just resumed from sleep? That will help distinguish a stale connected indicator from the separate reconnect-after-resume problem.

title: Mouse Without Borders within PowerToys connectivity issues
